request: The systems biology team has collected three assays from the same volunteers and has agreed that all three must remain distinct layers in the statistical model. The sponsor will not accept running several pairwise models, concatenating two assays into a single layer, or discarding the least complete assay. Sample matching and finite numeric measurements have already been checked, so the unresolved issue is specifically the number of independently modeled layers supported by this registered workflow. Please judge the exact requested model, because a different workflow or an approximate workaround would not meet the signed protocol. Can one DRAGON model use three independently modeled layers: RNA, protein and metabolite tables, without merging layers or omitting a modality?
